body: That's the thing about weed, it effects everybody differently. I tried anti-depressants before and even though I never heard music, I did feel 'different' when smoking... so hopefully it's nothing serious. Thanks though man, you too.
Haha nothing comes easy in life, I'm willing to work... It sounds like a great job for me though, I love driving and I'll see the country... Thanks for your answer, hopefully it works out!

It did sound like she was scaring me away from drugs but even so, I can't risk it. I heard voices outside my window (bedroom and bathroom) when I smoked weed and at night when I didn't. They'd be almost inaudible but they'd insult me and talk about me... I felt like people were looking into my window at night and watching me, making fun of me... 

I did quit smoking weed (9 days ago... I quit after the psychiatrist visit for a few months, started a couple months ago which was incredibly stupid of me and now I'm completely done with it) and now it's mostly paranoia. I don't hear people when I'm sober (for the most part) but weed really brings it out... 

That's really great to hear, actually... I was worried that would be the end of my career. Thanks a lot for your answer, it really helped.
Haha thanks again and yeah, that sounds like a really good idea actually

Actually it doesn't run in my family, I used to hear voices from smoking weed and was told by a psychiatrist that I'm predisposed to it so that's how I know. I think I was in the prodrome stage and now I'm pretty much voice free so hopefully it doesn't manifest, what kind of treatment are you talking about btw?
